annotations.title: Read a web page or PDF as Markdown

description: Read a web page or PDF found during a search and get its main content as clean Markdown (or plain text), with title, author, language, date, word count and optionally the links. Typical uses: a company's articles of association (statuts) in PDF, a BODACC notice, a company website, an article. HTML and PDF (first 50 pages) are detected automatically. Static pages only (no JavaScript), robots.txt respected, public part only (paywall_suspected flags teasers). Give an absolute http(s) URL on port 80/443; max_chars 1000-100000 (default 30000). Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base via x402. You are not charged when the call fails or finds nothing.

format.description: markdown (default) or text (plain text, no Markdown syntax)

links.description: Also return the absolute links found in the main content (max 200)

max_chars.description: Maximum length of the content; cut at a paragraph end, with truncated: true

url.description: Page or PDF to read: absolute http(s) URL, ports 80/443, max 2048 chars, e.g. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Markdown
